newsitem.title: CHINA: Volkswagen China sales seen brisk in '97.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen China sales seen brisk in '97.

text.p: Sales in China of Volkswagen's locally made Santana sedan car are expected to remain brisk in 1997 despite a sluggish national market, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
Shanghai Volkswagen, a subsidiary of Volkswagen AG, has received orders for more than 100,000 cars for the first half of this year, the newspaper said.
The Santana is China's biggest selling car, holding 52 per cent market share in 1996 and with a sales-production ratio of 99.95 per cent, it said.
Shanghai Volkswagen sold 200,000 Santanas in China in 1996, it said.
